items.source: Note that the present Lifecycle interface is only supported on top-level singleton beans. On any other component, the Lifecycle interface will remain undetected and hence ignored. Also, note that the extended SmartLifecycle interface provides sophisticated integration with the application context's startup and shutdown phases.
items.translation: 请注意，当前的 Lifecycle 接口仅支持顶层单例 Bean。在其他任何组件上，Lifecycle 接口将保持未被检测到的状态，因此会被忽略。此外，请注意扩展的SmartLifecycle接口提供了与应用程序上下文启动和关闭阶段的复杂集成。

items.source: Can be used for direct invocations or for management operations via JMX. In the latter case, the MBeanExporter will typically be defined with an InterfaceBasedMBeanInfoAssembler, restricting the visibility of activity-controlled components to the Lifecycle interface.
items.translation: 可用于直接调用或通过 JMX 执行管理操作。在后一种情况下，通常将 MBeanExporter 与一个 InterfaceBasedMBeanInfoAssembler 一起定义，从而将受生命周期控制的组件的活动可见性限制在 Lifecycle 接口。

items.source: Can be implemented by both components (typically a Spring bean defined in a Spring context) and containers (typically a Spring ApplicationContext itself). Containers will propagate start/stop signals to all components that apply within each container, for example, for a stop/restart scenario at runtime.
items.translation: 可由两个组件实现（通常是在 Spring 上下文中定义的 Spring Bean），也可由容器实现（通常是 Spring ApplicationContext 本身）。容器会将启动/停止信号传播到每个容器中适用的所有组件，例如用于运行时的停止/重启场景。

items.source: In the case of a container, this will return true only if all components that apply are currently running.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，仅当所有适用的组件当前都在运行时，此方法才返回 `true`。

items.source: Note that this stop notification is not guaranteed to come before destruction: On regular shutdown, Lifecycle beans will first receive a stop notification before the general destruction callbacks are being propagated; however, on hot refresh during a context's lifetime or on aborted refresh attempts, a given bean's destroy method will be called without any consideration of stop signals upfront.
items.translation: 请注意，此停止通知并不保证在销毁之前发出： 在常规关闭过程中，Lifecycle 圈会先接收停止通知，然后再传播通用的销毁回调；然而，在上下文生命周期期间的热刷新或中止的刷新尝试中，给定 bean 的销毁方法将在不考虑任何预先停止信号的情况下被调用。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is already running.
items.translation: 如果组件已经在运行，则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate a hard start signal to all
components that apply, even to non-auto-startup components.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，这将向所有适用的组件传播硬启动信号，即使包括非自动启动的组件。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is not running (not started yet).
items.translation: 如果组件尚未运行（尚未启动），则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate the stop signal to all components
that apply.
items.translation: 对于容器，这将向所有适用的组件传播停止信号。

items.source: Check whether this component is currently running.
items.translation: 检查该组件当前是否正在运行。

items.source:
Stop this component, typically in a synchronous fashion, such that the component is
fully stopped upon return of this method.
items.translation: 停止此组件，通常以同步方式执行，使得该方法返回时组件已完全停止。

items.source: whether the component is currently running
items.translation: 该组件当前是否正在运行
